goal: Prevent initial block download from stalling when querying peers that have no new headers
Allow nodes to release the sync slot and query other peers instead of hanging on empty header responses
reviewability: Ready for review with clean functional test coverage and passing CI
Open comments are limited to minor documentation requests and test clarifications
agreement: Concept approval and test assistance after fixing an expired backoff bug on late responses (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an indefinite stall during initial headers sync when peers return empty headers
Inbound and manual peers cannot be evicted, so a peer without new headers locks the sync slot completely
Prevents node startup and initial sync from hanging indefinitely when connecting to peers that are behind
